issues.desc: background.md "## Trigger Event" ("That story pins a (command,selector) on the intent...") and checklist.json CHK-001/CHK-003 context repeatedly use the term selector ("(command,selector)", "verification:{command,selector}", "--command/--selector") without ever explaining what a selector represents or checks (per the actual merged B-ec67 mechanism in packages/main/src/handlers/checklist.ts, a selector is a substring that must appear in the captured command output to prove the verifier genuinely ran). A fresh reader with no B-ec67 context cannot judge why CHK-001 must resolve/pass through this field or why CHK-003s guard must compare --selector.

background.md "## Key Insights" cites "the class of false-command mistakes (the F-045/F-049/F-050/F-061 family)" without any inline explanation of what these F-xxx identifiers are or where they are documented; they do not appear anywhere else in B-1507s background.md, index.json, or checklist.json, so a standalone reader cannot verify or trace them.

checklist.json CHK-004 context states RED-first per CLAUDE.md ("RED-first per CLAUDE.md. Cover: verification_run executes..."), but a full-text grep of CLAUDE.md (1076 lines) at /Users/jek/Documents/Work/proofbound/CLAUDE.md finds no occurrence of RED-first, TDD, or test-first as a defined convention anywhere; the cited documentation authority does not actually contain/support the discipline being invoked.
